recipe.title: Beef rendang
recipe.notes: We got this recipe from Gabby after she made it for us when Esther was a couple of weeks old.

i.n: chili powder (or more to taste, or omit for children)

method.s: Combine the eight spice paste ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Heat oil in a pan or small pot and fry spice paste for five minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer to slow cooker, add the remaining ingredients other than salt, and stir to combine.
Cover, then cook on low for eight to 10 hours.
Season to taste with salt, remove cinnamon stick, then serve over steamed rice with diced cucumber, salad, roti or naan.
